method: 386 completed games of ESPN play-by-play. All positions converted from absolute yardlines to yards-from-own-goal for the possessing team. EP grid fitted on the same data (down x distance-bucket x 5-yard bin, >=8 samples, hierarchical fallback); EPA/play uses line-of-scrimmage plays only, excludes penalised plays, and scores turnovers as -EP(opponent at new position). Success rate = first-down/TD conversion (3rd/4th &<=2 counts with >=half distance). Explosive play = >=15 net yards. Field position = mean drive start (yards from own goal) and forced_field_pos = mean opponent drive start measured from our goal (higher = better defense). Opponent-adjusted metric = team value minus the mean of its opponents' season values.
